name: Nightwatch Crossbow
body:
Price 22,800 gp; Slot none; CL 5th; Weight 7 lbs.; Aura faint evocation

DESCRIPTION

This +1 heavy crossbow is crafted from dark ebony wood and has the image of an eye flanked by two crescent moons carved onto each limb. An enchanted piece of circular glass is attached to the bridge of a nightwatch crossbow, allowing the wielder to peer through it while wielding the crossbow and see living creatures up to 120 feet away as though he had darkvision. This negates any attack roll penalties or miss chance from concealment due to darkness, unless it is magical darkness. This does not reveal invisible creatures and the wielder must still succeed at a Perception check to notice hidden creatures, but the nightwatch crossbow negates any bonuses on Stealth checks granted to creatures hidden by dim light or darkness. Once per day, a nightwatch crossbow may fire a bolt that bursts into daylight after it hits a target creature or 5-ft. square. This daylight persists for 50 minutes.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 11,400 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells daylight, faerie fire
